950-4222-8328.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Freed from the Real attached to Fatestitcher.
Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.
950-4222-8328.notablePrerequisites: Rikala has exactly three tide counters on it.
950-4222-8328.description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Rikala triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat from step 1

7282-7824-8160.easyPrerequisites:
Kwia's ability hasn't triggered this turn.
You have a way to gain life.
7282-7824-8160.description:
Gain life.
Kwia triggers, creating two Lotus tokens due to Bard.
Activate a Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating two token copies of the Lotus token.
Activate two Loti by tapping and sacrificing them, adding six mana of any color.
Repeat from step 4.
7282-7824-8160.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Chrome Dome can target other artifacts as desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6664-8201.notablePrerequisites:
You control five or more Towns.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6664-8201.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3899-4375-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

147-728-7166.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-728-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

586-864-997-3125-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-997-3125-7396.description:
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius, History Chaser.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

443-2738-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Magus of the Bridge, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2248-5233-7857.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.

1003-3661-6516-7039.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-3661-6516-7039.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1594-2781-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

670-1619-5887-6149.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-5887-6149.description:
Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Stirring Bard until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, causing Stirring Bard to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Stirring Bard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Stirring Bard trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Werefox Bodyguard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Stirring Bard until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-4772-7704.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doubling Season and Doc Samson.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

5361-7009-7334.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
5361-7009-7334.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Neutrinos.
5361-7009-7334.description:
Activate Auton Soldier using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare The Neutrinos as an attacker, triggering its ability, blinking Auton Soldier. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

3991-4681-6798.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1978-2750-6478.description:
Cause Arbor Adherent to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {5}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat from step 2.

1895-2060-4518-6930.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1849-6188-6911.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent. There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-6188-6911.description:
Declare Fear of Missing Out as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Fear of Missing Out, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Fear of Missing Out that isn't legendary.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters, it triggers, causing you to rummage
During your next combat phase, declare Fear of Missing Out and the Fear of Missing Out token as attackers.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, causing you to untap the nontoken Fear of Missing Out and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

4140-4186-4509.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying {2}{G}.
Cast Giada by paying {1}{W}.
When Giada enters, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Scurry Oak's second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel due to Divine Visitation that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each other Angel you control due to Giada.
When the Angel token enters, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.

339-677-2034-4885.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2043-4659-5491-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copies of Magic Pot that is a 1/1 Soldiers and a Map token
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot and Map, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Magic Pot token dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure and a Map token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Map or Treasure, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

204-1858-2056-2633-4927.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-1858-2056-2633-4927.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2428-3591-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have a card in hand.
392-2428-3591-6282.description:
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
Resolve all Harnfel abilities.

1247-5536-5986.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Whisperer of the Wilds and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-5536-5986.description:
Activate Rex using Whisperer of the Wilds's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2438-3490-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1402-2136-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Orthion.
1402-2136-2178.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Diamond Lion with haste.
Activate the Diamond Lion token by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {R}{R}{R}.
When the Diamond Lion token dies, Orthion triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Diamond Lion tokens and/or target any other creature.

914-2136-2178-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2136-2178-4050.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Dockside Extortionist token, adding {R}.
When the Dockside Extortionist token dies, Orthion triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may instead use Orthion's second ability to make copies of any creature(s) you control.

962-1283-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Yurlok.
Yurlok does not have summoning sickness.
962-1283-4222.description:
Activate Yurlok by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G} to their mana pool.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability twice by paying {2}, untapping Yurlok.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to your next phase, causing each player to lose life equal to the mana in their mana pool.

1579-2757-4499.description:
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Visionary Augmenter.
Visionary Augmenter enters the battlefield triggering its Fabricate ability, choosing to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Visionary Augmenter, untapping the basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Servo token, untapping the basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Servo token, untapping the basic land.
Repeat.

2825-2940-4028.notablePrerequisites: Zhur-Taa Druid and Elite Arcanist do not have summoning sickness.
2825-2940-4028.description:
Activate Zhur-Taa Druid by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {1} and tapping it, casting a copy of Triton Tactics without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Triton Tactics, untapping Zhur-Taa Druid and Elite Arcanist and giving them +0/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

364-1987-2493-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Archaeomancer, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
